site_engineer.label: Site engineer
site_engineer.purpose: Submit the site requirement and BOQ, answer technical corrections and track the case.
requiredDetails: case reference for an existing request

project_manager.label: Project manager / procurement coordinator
project_manager.purpose: Perform the procurement-team coordination tasks for the assigned project without approving their own recommendation.
requiredDetails: current BOQ revision and correction status
at least three eligible RFQ recipients
quote source, rates, GST, payment, delivery and exclusions
comparison, negotiation evidence and recommendation rationale

hod.label: HOD / management
hod.purpose: Review the current recommendation, vendor, scope and rates; explicitly approve or request changes through the agreed human approval route.

workflow.description: Submit requirement and BOQ through the form, email or WhatsApp.
workflow.gate: Extracted voice and document values require human review.

workflow.description: Review BOQ, obtain corrections and resolve ERP mappings, duplicates and proposed new items.
workflow.gate: A proposed item is not a live ERP item creation.

workflow.description: Send the current reviewed BOQ and RFQ to at least three eligible vendors.
workflow.gate: Require at least three distinct evidenced eligible vendors and an explicit dispatch confirmation.

workflow.description: Vendors return quotations, normally through email.
workflow.gate: Missing rates, GST, payment terms, delivery or exclusions remain unresolved.

workflow.description: Compare the same scope, consider evidenced vendor history, record negotiations and recommend.
workflow.gate: No invented vendor history or silent scope/unit conversions.

workflow.description: Review and explicitly approve vendor and rates, or request changes.
workflow.gate: Bind the human decision to the current vendor, rates, scope and recommendation revision.

workflow.description: Record accounts verification/registration evidence and prepare a draft work order.
workflow.gate: The project manager records external evidence; they do not impersonate accounts or certify banking information.

workflow.description: Obtain authorised approval/signature, then issue the signed order to vendor and site and track execution.
workflow.gate: HOD status alone does not confer signature authority. Never send an unsigned work order as an order.
